title: ACP: no tool_call session update before request_permission

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear and actionable description of a bug in ACP mode where tool_call session updates are omitted prior to session/request_permission. It provides exact code references, expected vs actual behavior according to the ACP tool calls spec, reproduction steps, and debug logs.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix requires emitting a tool_call session update with status 'pending' prior to requestPermission in packages/cli/src/acp/acpSession.ts and updating unit test expectations in packages/cli/src/acp/acpSession.test.ts. This is a localized single-file logic fix with a clear root cause and low blast radius.

summary.problem: In ACP mode, when a tool requires user confirmation, runTool() sends session/request_permission without sending a preceding tool_call session update to the client.
summary.root_cause: In packages/cli/src/acp/acpSession.ts, this.sendUpdate with sessionUpdate: 'tool_call' is only executed in the else branch when confirmationDetails is falsy. In the if (confirmationDetails) branch, requestPermission is called directly without emitting a tool_call update first.
summary.context: According to the ACP tool calls specification, the agent should report a tool_call session update (with status 'pending' when confirmation is required) prior to requesting permission, allowing clients to track the tool call lifecycle.

steps: In packages/cli/src/acp/acpSession.ts, locate runTool() where confirmationDetails is handled.

Before calling this.connection.requestPermission, call await this.sendUpdate with sessionUpdate: 'tool_call', status 'pending', and the tool call details (toolCallId, title, content, locations, kind).

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When a tool execution requires confirmation, a tool_call session update with status 'pending' is emitted via sendUpdate before connection.requestPermission is invoked.
verification_steps: In packages/cli/src/acp/acpSession.test.ts, update or add unit test cases where requestPermission is mocked to verify that mockConnection.sessionUpdate was called with sessionUpdate: 'tool_call' and status: 'pending' before requestPermission was called.
